name_raw: Place to stay in Nusa Penida - Lovers Lookout: Private Penida Room w/ Ocean View
description: Wake to ocean views and soft morning light from this private room on Nusa Penida. The spacious room has a queen bed, air conditioning, a private bathroom, and a place to work. Take in the coast from your balcony or spend time at the shared pool. This is a more secluded base, about 14.6 km from Toya Pakeh Harbour; island roads and traffic can make trips longer than map estimates. Food and shopping choices nearby are limited, so plan meals, drinking water and a scooter or driver before you arrive.
